After returning to the inn, I was making charms out of hemp cord
and the sea glass we gathered together with Victoire Pisa.

Whoa... A crab!?
...Phew, that was close, I almost stepped on it...!
Hehe... Now we match, don't we?

Where she turned her gaze...
lying in the crab's path was a pile of driftwood and debris.

As if welcomed by its companions,
the crab soon burrowed into the crevice between the rocks.

Yes, at this rate—...
I'll... go connect a path for it!

Um... if you'd like, would you take a walk with me?
I want to feel the beautiful sea up close. As a memory of our training camp.

Still, since we're here...
I want her to have it as a keepsake of today.

You aren't all by yourself anymore, are you?
I'm so glad... you were able to return to the circle where you feel safest.
Hehe... My words were nothing more than a tiny spark.
Yes, thank you very much for today as well.

...Forward, ever forward. No matter how small the step, as long as
you carry hope as you go... you will find your way back to warmth.

May those little ones...
continue to live lives full of happiness.

Whenever she found treasures left behind by the sea,
lying all alone in the sand—

Yes...♪
Oh, there's another over there...
(And then, the circle of those little ones—)
"Let's trade!"—the warm voices echoed in unison.

Summer training camp. Victoire Pisa dedicated herself to
her daily workouts with truly flawless effort.
—Oh... Is that little one...?

It made it back... safely.
This was the precious place... it wanted to return to all along.

Indeed. Hehe... Perhaps they got worried and couldn't sit still,
thinking, 'Where are they? Are they running late?' and came to meet it.

...! ...Fufu. Even before putting it into words...
our hearts were already one and the same—

Having spent so much time... and pouring so much care into it,
I've grown truly attached to this piece.

(Your happiness... is my joy.
May your happiness and mine remain together, always...)

Venturing out to sea all alone, embarking on a long journey...
only to arrive from somewhere far away. A beautiful, happy circle.

As long as you have hope, you will surely reach a warm place—
Watching over the little one striving ahead, as if weaving a prayer... believing with all her heart.
You're very skilled. I can feel just how earnestly you wish to weave it tightly.
...It's okay. You're not alone anymore.

(Trainer... such a serious gaze...
Treating each little step with such care, such tenderness...)

It's going well. At this rate—... Oh?
My...!

I see the very same light shining in your eyes.
Yes, surely—...
And... may this bond never come undone.

Yes...! Yes, of course...! 
Please let me watch over it with you. Praying for this little one's safety—
Fufu... Yes, absolutely...!

The crab toddles along, weaving through the bustling crowd.
However, such a tiny crab is hard for passersby to notice—

Sea glass... how lovely. What used to be sharp fragments have taken on
such a gentle glow... It's just like a jewel polished by the ocean.

With an angelic smile, she gently
gathered each piece one by one.

Let's keep going just like this... weaving it
to envelop the sea glass. ...—Like so.

I see... Even though it's so small and all alone,
feeling helpless... is it trying to find its way home...?

Little crab, right this way.
...That's it, one step at a time...
Um, if you'd like—

You did it...! Every single weave is so
neat and aligned, so beautiful... Wonderful work.
Trainer? Is something the matter?
...—Here too.

It's all right... Just wait a moment, okay?
You'll be able to move forward soon.
Navigating through the sea of feet, the crab safely reached an open space.

Let us keep connecting them.
From now on... endlessly, unchangingly. With our own two hands.

Continuing our walk, we eventually find ourselves in a crowded spot.
Casually looking down at my feet, I notice—

(Ah... that's how it was...
All this time, forever and ever...)

The sunset today... is so beautiful.
It seems so much brighter than usual.

...That's right, thread it through this loop—...
and pull tight. That's how you weave it.
Arriving at the rocky shore, several crabs came into view.
Guided patiently by Victoire Pisa, at long last—
Phew...
